description: Questions about the generated sample documents. key_facts are verbatim phrases from static (non-computed) document text; unanswerable questions should make retrieval report insufficient evidence.

questions.question: How many days after delivery can a customer request a refund?
questions.ground_truth: Customers may request a refund within 30 days of delivery.

questions.question: What applies to opened electronics that are not defective?
questions.ground_truth: Opened non-defective electronics may be returned within 14 days and are subject to a 10% restocking fee.

questions.question: How long does it take for an approved refund to be issued?
questions.ground_truth: Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method within 7 business days.

questions.question: Which items cannot be refunded?
questions.ground_truth: Gift cards and items marked final sale cannot be refunded.

questions.question: What is the first response target for customer support?
When must a refund be escalated to a team lead?
questions.ground_truth: Level 2 escalation to the team lead applies to refunds above $500 or repeated complaints.

questions.question: Why did revenue decline in Q3 2026 according to our internal reports?
questions.ground_truth: The Q3 decline is concentrated in Wireless Earbuds Pro (lost demand after the spring promotion and competitor price cuts) and Smart Home Hub (supply shortages from August onward).

questions.question: What drove growth in Q2 2026?
questions.ground_truth: A spring promotion (10% discount, 28 April to 12 May 2026) drove volumes; Wireless Earbuds Pro and Smart Home Hub were the main contributors.

questions.question: Did we run a company-wide promotion in Q1 2026?
questions.ground_truth: No company-wide promotion ran in Q1 2026.

questions.question: What discount was offered during Black Friday week?
questions.ground_truth: A 15% discount on all products from 24 to 30 November 2025.

questions.question: What should marketing do about Smart Home Hub advertising?
questions.ground_truth: Pause paid advertising for Smart Home Hub until stock is replenished to avoid cancellations.

questions.question: What is the win-back tactic for at-risk customers?
questions.ground_truth: A win-back email with a time-limited 10% offer before they reach 90 days; at risk means 46-90 days since last order.

questions.question: What are the churn reduction targets?
questions.ground_truth: Reduce the churn rate by 5 percentage points over the next two quarters.

questions.question: Which customers are at higher churn risk because of supply issues?
questions.ground_truth: Customers affected by Smart Home Hub cancellations in August and September 2026.

questions.question: What is our parental leave policy?
questions.ground_truth: The documents do not contain this information.

questions.question: What is the CEO's salary?
questions.ground_truth: The documents do not contain this information.
